LESSON: KITCHEN AND BACKYARD GARDENING

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: FOOD PRODUCTION PROCESSES
Topic 2.1: Kitchen and Backyard Gardening

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Kitchen and Backyard Gardening
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How does kitchen garden contribute to food production?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. explain the role of kitchen and backyard garden in food production

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Kitchen and Backyard Gardening

Teach
• Observe Kitchen and Backyard Gardening in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Kitchen and Backyard Gardening (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Kitchen and Backyard Gardening.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Kitchen and Backyard Gardening.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Kitchen and Backyard Gardening.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• explain the role of kitchen and backyard garden in food production

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Kitchen and Backyard Gardening.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for Kitchen and Backyard Gardening: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How does kitchen garden contribute to food production?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• explain the role of kitchen and backyard garden in food production

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
